<translate>
'''Hell Ogres''' are the red and blue ogres that walk the floor of Hell, below the clouds of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]]. They only hunt Evil-aligned players. Another ogre, the '''Hell Ogre''' standing next to [[Special:MyLanguage/King Yemma|King Yemma]], is a quest NPC who knows where [[Special:MyLanguage/Janemba|Janemba]] sleeps.
</translate>

<translate>
== Red and Blue Ogres ==

Two ogres share the same stats and behavior: the '''Red Ogre''' and the '''Blue Ogre'''.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Ogre</translate> !! <translate>Health</translate> !! <translate>Damage</translate> !! <translate>Spawn weight</translate> !! <translate>Group size</translate>
|-
| <translate>Red Ogre</translate> || 200 || 20 || 60 || 1–2

<translate>
== Spawning ==

The ogres spawn on Hell's ground and stone blocks, with at most 4 ogres within 48 blocks.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior ==

The ogres are '''only hostile to Evil-aligned players''' (alignment 0–40). Anyone else is left alone unless they hit an ogre first, which brings the nearby ogres in too. They fight on the '''Novice''' AI tier. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|Alignment]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops ==

The ogres drop nothing.
</translate>

<translate>
== The Hell Ogre quest NPC ==

In the cloud realm of the Otherworld, next to King Yemma, stands the '''Hell Ogre''', a quest NPC. He tells you about [[Special:MyLanguage/Janemba|Janemba]], whether it is awake and, once its lair is known, gives you its location at the bottom of Hell.
</translate>
